import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int mod1 = 998244353;
    static final int mod2 = 1000000007;
    static final int base = 1000000;
    static List<Integer>[] v = new ArrayList[7];
    static int[] sum = new int[7];
    static long n;
    static long cnt = 0;
    static long ans = 0;

    public static void explore1(int level, int prefix) {
        cnt++;
        int val = (int)((cnt - prefix + mod1) % mod1);
        v[level].add(val);
        sum[level] = (sum[level] + val) % mod2;
        if (level == 6) return;
        for (int digit = 0; digit < 10; digit++) {
            explore1(level + 1, prefix * 10 + digit);
        }
    }

    public static void explore2(long x) {
        if (x > n) return;
        if (x * base + base - 1 <= n && x * base * 10 > n) {
            long currentCount = cnt;
            for (int i = 0, multiplier = 1; i <= 6; i++, multiplier *= 10) {
                int size = v[i].size();
                int difference = (int)(((currentCount - x * multiplier) % mod1 + mod1) % mod1);
                int position = lowerBound(v[i], (int)(mod1 - difference));
                ans = (ans + (long)difference * size + sum[i]) % mod2;
                ans = (ans - (long)mod1 * (size - position) % mod2 + mod2) % mod2;
                cnt += size;
            }
            return;
        }
        cnt++;
        ans = (ans + ((cnt - x) % mod1 + mod1) % mod1) % mod2;
        for (int digit = 0; digit <= 9; digit++) {
            explore2(x * 10 + digit);
        }
    }

    public static int lowerBound(List<Integer> list, int value) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= value) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            v[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        explore1(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(v[i]);
        }
        cnt = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 9; i++) {
            explore2(i);
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
